shots.prompt: Prestige skincare extreme macro cinematography from this authentic real product photograph. Preserve the exact visible section of the horizontal transparent glass pipette, its burgundy-tinted liquid and the visible edge of the burgundy bottle. Tight optical detail on the existing pipette tip and liquid meniscus. A tiny soft highlight glints at the photographed tip without changing the shape or color of the liquid. Only one centimeter of lateral camera drift. Soft ivory window light, existing leaf shadows, restrained cream and dusty plum palette, true glass refraction. The glass remains rigid and in the exact original position. Do not extend the pipette, add a cap, invent a new bottle or create a falling liquid string. No hands, text, logos or cuts. No speech, whisper, singing or music.
